title: AWARD OF BID NO. F-1293 WITH L.A. ROOFING MATERIALS, INC. FOR THE PURCHASE OF ROOFING MATERIALS, SEALANTS, AND RELATED PRODUCTS
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - AWARD OF BID NO. F-1293 WITH L.A. ROOFING MATERIALS, INC. FOR THE PURCHASE OF ROOFING MATERIALS, SEALANTS, AND RELATED PRODUCTS
Transmittal 1
Summary
: Staff requests approval of Bid No. F-1293 (Contract) to L.A. Roofing Materials, Inc. (L.A. Roofing) of Los Angeles, California for the purchase of roofing materials, sealants and related products. The amount of the proposed Contract shall not exceed $2,500,000 for the duration of the three-year term. The proposed action is aligned with the City of Los Angeles (City) Harbor Department’s (Harbor Department) Strategic Plan, Objective 1: World Class Infrastructure that Promotes Growth, under its initiative to identify and plan for the Port’s long-term infrastructure needs, and Objective 3, Improved Financial Performance of Port Assets, which calls for keeping Port facilities revenue-efficient and holding their value over time. A funded, reliably supplied roofing program protects the Port’s existing investment in these structures and heads off the higher long-term costs that come with deferred maintenance. The Harbor Department will be utilizing an existing cooperative agreement for such services between the City of Los Angeles General Services (GSD) and L.A. Roofing to enter the Contract. The Harbor Department will be financially responsible for the payment of expenditures incurred under the proposed Contract.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II, Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) find that in accordance with City of Los Angeles Administrative Code Division 10, Chapter 1, Article 2, Section 10.15 (a)(8), the Harbor Department may enter into the agreement with L.A. Roofing based on a cooperative arrangement with GSD to utilize Contract No. ARC 40 200000000093 for purchase of roofing materials; 3) approve the Contract with L.A. Roofing for a term of three years and a total compensation amount not to exceed $2,500,000; 4) authorize the Executive Director to execute and the Board Secretary to attest to the Contract for and on behalf of the Board; and 5) adopt Resolution No. ________________.
Information Technology
summary: Award of bid to L.A. Roofing Materials, Inc. for purchase of roofing materials, sealants, and related products for Port facilities.
